<subject>Draft of Maple & Crown Telecom Inc. Transition Team Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David,   As we just discussed, this is the transition memo suggesting that you place a call to Stephen Mclaughlin.   As noted in the memo, we are still working through with the lawyers what leave status our employees would be required to take while serving on the private network upgrade and the publicly funded spectrum allocation.  The answer to this question may determine their willingness to serve, in some cases.
</body>
<quoted>
 
</quoted>
